cards.quote: Panetolikos F.C., the beloved football team, was set to take on their arch-rivals, and the town was electric. In the midst of the chaos, a towering figure emerged from the team's hotel, his dreadlocks bouncing with each step. Kevin Smith, the American basketball sensation, had traded in his sneakers for a pair of football boots, and the locals couldn't get enough of him. As he made his way to the team bus, Kevin was stopped by a group of awestruck children, who begged for autographs and selfies. He obliged, flashing his famous smile and signing jerseys with a flourish. It was a far cry from the NBA courts he once dominated, but Kevin had found a new passion in the beautiful game. Coach Dimitri, a gruff but lovable man with a thick Greek accent, clapped Kevin on the back as he boarded the bus. "Today, my friend, we make history. We take down those pretenders from Athens and show them what Panetolikos is made of!"

raw_card.claim: Kevin Smith represents the Richmond Spiders men's basketball team.
